name: comp-591
title: AI Model Selector Header
description: A sparse dark chat header holding one model selector button on the left, with a bot icon and the active model name, and a temporary-chat icon plus user avatar on the right.
use: A chat or AI product must let people switch model with the trade-offs visible.
avoid: Only four fixed models are listed, and the descriptions are static text with no pricing or limits.
a11y: The select and chat button are labelled, but the option descriptions are visual text and not announced as hints. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark header with a single ghost button at the left showing a bot icon, the model name Orion-Alpha 4.5 and a down chevron; at the right a dashed chat bubble and a round avatar. Opening the button shows a wide panel titled Models with four rows of name plus description.
behaves: Clicking the model button opens a list of four AI models, each with a one-line description and a tick beside the active one. Choosing a model swaps the trigger label and closes the panel.
customise: Model names, descriptions and the default are written in the file; the user menu is a separate piece.
weight: light: One select button, one icon button and a four-row menu.
